inventory_scope: All Git tree blobs in the PR snapshot, excluding this manifest itself to avoid a self-referential hash/size. The Awakenology repository is represented by a pinned Git submodule commit and a separate complete file-tree manifest; its external blobs are not counted as local ScienceOfOrigin repository blobs.
identifier_note: Existing inventory_entry_id values were preserved; new entries appended. Git blob SHA is Git's object identifier, not a SHA-256 checksum. The manifest excludes itself. Git submodules are recorded separately and their external blobs are not counted as local repository blobs.
